t: This section and section 5 shall become effective on the date of enactment of this Act. The provisions of the first section and section 2 of this Act shall become effective on January 15, 1967. The provisions of section 3 of this Act shall become effective on July 1, 1967.

fable.w: This section only sets effective dates for various provisions of the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government; there is no tempting participation language at all.

qwen_block.w: This section solely establishes the effective dates for various parts of the Act. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or comment periods mentioned.
qwen_block.s: This section and section 5 shall become effective on the date of enactment of this Act. The provisions of the first section and section 2 of this Act shall become effective on January 15, 1967. The provisions of section 3 of this Act shall become effective on July 1, 1967.

opus.w: This section only sets when the Act's sections take effect: the date of enactment, January 15, 1967, and July 1, 1967. It involves no outside party in any federal decision. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue, and the references to other sections are just effective-date mechanics.
opus.b:
1. **Reasoning:** This section only sets effective dates. It is tempting to treat the word "provisions" or the cross-references to other sections as signs of a process, but that reading fails. The text has no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation or right to sue. It also involves no actor outside the federal government.
